alerts.title: EU cultural-goods import documentary requirements are operational
alerts.summary: The import-licence / importer-statement requirements under Regulation (EU) 2019/880 became applicable on 28 June 2025 when the ICG electronic system became operational. Applicability depends on the cultural-good category and thresholds.

alerts.title: France’s 5.5% VAT regime applies broadly to qualifying art
alerts.summary: French tax guidance confirms the reduced 5.5% VAT rate for qualifying works of art, collectors’ items and antiques, including imports and qualifying intra-EU acquisitions, with separate treatment where the margin scheme applies.
